title: Breaking Bad — Mr Chips becomes Scarface

hook.quote: I am the one who knocks!
hook.context: Xotini Skyler xavotir olib, uni xavf ostida deb o'ylaganda, Walter g'urur bilan javob beradi: "Xavf ostidagi men emasman — eshikni taqillatadigan menman." "the one who..." — "... qiladigan odam" degan konstruksiya.

reading: Walter White is a quiet chemistry teacher in Albuquerque. He is brilliant, but his life has been full of disappointments. On his fiftieth birthday he learns that he has serious cancer.
The doctor tells him that he has only a few years to live. Walter is worried about money: he says that his family will have nothing after he dies.
By chance, he meets Jesse Pinkman, a former student who works in the illegal drug business. Walter tells Jesse that he wants to become his partner.
At first, Walter promises himself that he is doing it only for his family. He tells his wife that he is working late at school.
But slowly he changes. He discovers that he enjoys being powerful and feared. He even chooses a new name for himself: Heisenberg.
His brother-in-law, Hank, is a police officer who is hunting for Heisenberg. Hank has no idea that the criminal he is looking for is sitting at the same dinner table.
In the final episode Walter finally admits the truth. He tells Skyler that he did it for himself, because he liked it and he was good at it.

grammar.title: Reported Speech: he said that...
explain: Birovning gapini o'zimiz yetkazganda zamon odatda **bir pog'ona orqaga** suriladi: "I **am** tired" → He said (that) he **was** tired. "I **will** help" → She said she **would** help.
Jadval: am/is → was · do → did · did / have done → had done · will → would · can → could.
**say** va **tell** farqi: **say** (that) ... — kimga ekani aytilmaydi; **tell + odam** + (that): He **told me** that... / He **said** that... ("He said me" — xato).
Olmosh va vaqt ham o'zgaradi: "I'm working late **today**" → He said **he** was working late **that day**. Savollar: "Where **are** you?" → She asked **where I was** (so'z tartibi oddiy gapdek).

exercises.q: "I am worried about money." → Walter said he ___ worried about money.
"I will help you." → Jesse said he ___ help me.
He ___ his wife that he was working late.

"I have lost my keys." → She said she ___ her keys.
